tags.name: Authentication
tags.description:
The Primis REST API is served over HTTPS. It has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts application/json request bodies, returns application/json responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs. An Authentication Token is required to authorise all API requests. There are 3 token types: JWT, Retailer API Key and CMS API key.
JWT: Provided on successful login of an account.
Retailer API key: Provided when adding an API Key to an integration
CMS API Key: Provided by a Primis Developer upon request
CMS API Key are used to communicate between Primis services and external services that are not associated with specific retailers For CMS and Retailer API Keys "Bearer is not required in the Header
For JWT requests: It must be set in the Authorization header of the API Request prepended with Bearer.
E.g. Bearer The-JWT-Token
